WITH site_esi AS (
    SELECT 
        s.zoneregistry,
        ROUND(CAST(AVG(100 - 2.5 * ABS(se.ambictemp - 20) - POWER(ABS((se.humepct - 50) / 2.0), 1.5) - 600.0 / (se.illumelux + 100)) AS numeric), 2) AS avg_suitability
    FROM sites s
    JOIN scanenvironment se ON se.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
    GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN avg_suitability > 85 THEN 'Optimal Scanning Conditions'
        WHEN avg_suitability >= 70 AND avg_suitability <= 85 THEN 'Good Scanning Conditions'
        WHEN avg_suitability >= 50 AND avg_suitability < 70 THEN 'Acceptable Scanning Conditions'
        ELSE 'Challenging Scanning Conditions'
    END AS eccs_category,
    COUNT(*) AS site_count
FROM site_esi
GROUP BY 
    CASE 
        WHEN avg_suitability > 85 THEN 'Optimal Scanning Conditions'
        WHEN avg_suitability >= 70 AND avg_suitability <= 85 THEN 'Good Scanning Conditions'
        WHEN avg_suitability >= 50 AND avg_suitability < 70 THEN 'Acceptable Scanning Conditions'
        ELSE 'Challenging Scanning Conditions'
    END
ORDER BY site_count DESC;
